items.title: Show HN: Lightweight FUSE-based encrypted, compressed filesystem for Linux
items.summary: A personal project for digging deeper into Linux system programming, ObFUSEcate implements a file backed virtual block device that automatically performs compression and encryption as blocks are accessed. This virtual device can be mounted via FUSE (requiring no root privileges) to provide, effectively, a "live" compressed, encrypted archive. Foolscap is the result, or at least the first version of that idea that's fleshed out enough to share here. It reads as you write and picks out the structure: characters, ideas, threads, what's left hanging.
